outcome: Presence of symptoms due to Moyamoya disease intrapartum
cohort: 27 pregnancies in 19 women with Moyamoya disease treated at the Department of Perinatology, National Cardiovascular Center, Japan, from 1983 to 2013
finding: Vaginal delivery with epidural anesthesia is a viable and safe option for women with Moyamoya disease, potentially reducing unnecessary cesarean sections.
mod_finding: No symptoms due to Moyamoya disease intrapartum were seen in the vaginal delivery cases.
